## Goal
- Sync IVX landing page to match app's InvestmentCard design AND unblock member registration end-to-end without SMTP by auto-confirming emails and auto-logging in after signup — across landing page, backend, AND mobile app

## Constraints & Preferences
- Do NOT call createApp — existing live IVX production; `<new_project>` tag is documented false positive (840+ files)
- Owner Ivan (iperez4242@gmail.com) sole authority; GitHub ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest branch main
- Owner approval phrases: CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE, CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY, CONFIRM_IVX_APK_UPLOAD, CONFIRM_IVX_SUPABASE_MIGRATION, CONFIRM_IVX_LANDING_UPLOAD, CONFIRM_IVX_CLOUDFRONT_INVALIDATE
- No fake data, no placeholder progress — honest about what can/cannot be done
- Owner token at `/tmp/owner_at.json`; re-mint via POST `https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/owner-passwordless-login` with `{"email":"iperez4242@gmail.com"}` — response field is `accessToken`; expires ~1hr
- GitHub commit API: `POST /api/ivx/developer-deploy/action` with `{action: "github_commit_file", input: {path, content, contentEncoding: "base64", message}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE"}`
- S3 upload: `POST /api/ivx/apk/presign-upload` with `{key, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_LANDING_UPLOAD"}` → returns `uploadUrl` + `publicUrl`; then PUT file to S3 with `Content-Type` header
- CloudFront invalidation: `POST /api/ivx/autonomy/cloudfront/invalidate` with `{paths, apply: true}` → returns `invalidationId`
- Supabase Management SQL: `POST /api/ivx/developer-deploy/action` with `{action: "supabase_execute_sql_management", input: {sql}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_SUPABASE_MIGRATION"}`
- Render deploy trigger: `POST /api/ivx/developer-deploy/action` with `{action: "render_trigger_deploy", confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY"}`
- AWS credentials live in backend Render runtime ONLY — never in bash sandbox
- Render auto-deploys from GitHub main branch pushes (can also be manually triggered)
- Watchman binary at `/usr/local/bin/watchman` was RENAMED to `.disabled` to fix Metro bundling
- JAVA_HOME must be `/usr/lib/jvm/jdk-17.0.13+11`; Android SDK at `/opt/android-sdk`

## Progress
### Done
- **LANDING PAGE SYNC — COMPLETED & DEPLOYED**:
  - `buildDealCardHtml()` rewritten in `index.html` to use app's InvestmentCard layout: photo gallery with counter + status badge, summary panel (Sale Price / Total Investment / ROI / Timeline), Project Timeline progress bar, min investment + ownership row, category chips (Tokenized/JV Deal/Buyer), developer name, View Deal + Invest Now CTAs, like/comment/save/share action row
  - Helper functions added: `getCategoryChips()`, `toggleDealDetails()`, `toggleDealLike()`, `toggleDealSave()`, `shareDeal()`, `openDealComments()`
  - "Project Reels" section removed from HTML (replaced with comment); `ivx-reels.js` script tag removed
  - Gallery slider init updated to handle both `.live-deal-gallery-slider` and `.ivx-card-gallery-slider` selectors
  - GitHub commit: `5e4ddfaf30fbb4c4a40336c03819e1ec17dd0792`
  - S3 upload: `index.html` → 468,572 bytes, ETag `99ae6727d33f22803ed331ae27428822`
  - CloudFront invalidation: `ICDM6K3VHPZGUDOCQQ0GVOR4M6` for `/`, `/index.html`, `/ivx-home-feed.js`, `/ivx-reels.js`
  - Live verified: `ivxholding.com` shows "Featured Deals" header, `ivx-app-card` (3), `ivx-card-status-badge` (5), `ivx-card-body` (2), `ivx-card-summary` (18), `ivx-card-timeline` (18), `ivx-card-actions` (2), `ivx-card-ctas` (3), `ivx-card-chip` (9)

- **BACKEND REGISTRATION FIX — COMPLETED & DEPLOYED & VERIFIED LIVE**:
  - `backend/services/ivx-member-database.ts`: `email_confirm: false` → `email_confirm: true` (auto-confirm on creation); `requiresVerification: true` → `false`
  - `backend/services/ivx-registration-orchestrator.ts`: `stage: 'EMAIL_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED'` → `stage: 'COMPLETED'` with `requiresVerification: false` (both new + duplicate-submission paths)
  - GitHub commits: `d5d7a0ad` (member-database), `4f8c5730` (orchestrator), `8f149199` (ivx-invest.js)
  - Render deployed all commits — runtime commit confirmed `8f149199e91b`
  - Existing unconfirmed Supabase auth users auto-confirmed via SQL: `UPDATE auth.users SET email_confirmed_at = COALESCE(email_confirmed_at, now()) WHERE email_confirmed_at IS NULL;` (succeeded, HTTP 201)

- **LANDING PAGE JS — COMPLETED & DEPLOYED & VERIFIED LIVE**:
  - `expo/ivxholding-landing/ivx-invest.js`: Registration success handler rewritten to auto-login via `supabase.auth.signInWithPassword()` immediately after signup, with fallback to manual sign-in
  - Uploaded to S3 (public URL: `https://ivxholding.com/ivx-invest.js`)
  - CloudFront invalidation: `I7CSDZ0032SR3Z36TIY3J8OBZA` for `/`, `/index.html`, `/ivx-invest.js`, `/ivx-reels.js`, `/ivx-portal.js`
  - Live verified: `grep -c 'auto-login'` confirms auto-login code present in served JS

- **LIVE REGISTRATION CANARY — PASSED TWICE**:
  - Canary 1 (`ivx-canary-nj1es3sb1s@example.test`): register → `stage: 'COMPLETED'`, `requiresVerification: false`, `authUserId: 6a253f08...` → login → `success: true`, `userId` matches → PASS
  - Canary 2 (`ivx-final-j8veffmtbp@example.test`): register → `stage: 'COMPLETED'`, `requiresVerification: false`, `authUserId: 95b20512...` → login → `success: true`, `userId` matches → PASS
  - Both proved: no email confirmation required, user can sign in immediately after registration

- **MOBILE APP REGISTRATION FIX — PARTIALLY EDITED (NOT YET COMMITTED)**:
  - `expo/app/signup.tsx`: After registration success, now auto-navigates to login after 1.5s delay instead of staying on "complete" step
  - `expo/app/member-register.tsx`: After `result.success && result.userId`, skips `setStep('Verify')` → goes directly to `setStep('Dashboard')`

  - **NOT YET DONE**: `expo/components/IVXAuthCard.tsx` still routes to `setStep('verify_email')` + sends email code after registration (line ~651-660) — needs fix to skip verification

  - **NONE OF THESE CHANGES ARE COMMITTED TO GITHUB YET**

- **PRIOR SESSION WORK** (all committed & deployed):
  - 300-item certification: PARTIAL (187 PASS / 14 FAIL / 18 BLOCKED / 81 NOT_APPLICABLE)
  - 18+ prior commits: colors.ts, _layout.tsx, home.tsx, crm.tsx, invest/index.tsx, profit-tools.tsx, DealVideoCard.tsx, TrustDealCard.tsx, app.config.ts, build.gradle, ivx-brand-config.ts, ChatScreen.tsx, 4 backend services

### In Progress
- **Mobile app registration fix** — `signup.tsx` and `member-register.tsx` edited but NOT committed; `auth-context.tsx`, `IVXAuthCard.tsx`, `QuickBuyModal.tsx` still need code changes
- **Supabase project-level `mailer_autoconfirm=true`** — backend action `update_supabase_auth_config` added to `ivx-developer-deploy-control.ts` but NOT committed/deployed; also need to call it once deployed
- **Backend `update_supabase_auth_config` action** — added to action type union, validation function, dispatch router, and implementation function, but NOT committed to GitHub

### Blocked
- **Supabase `auth.config` table** — does NOT exist; cannot use SQL to set `mailer_autoconfirm`. Must use Management API PATCH via `update_supabase_auth_config` action (needs deploy first)
- **SMTP** — still not configured; password resets and email notifications won't work (registration works without SMTP via auto-confirm)
- **Physical device QA** — no physical Android/iOS device in sandbox
- **APK v1.4.36 build** — JS bundling blocked by Watchman timeout in sandbox

## Key Decisions
- Auto-confirm member emails server-side (`email_confirm: true` in Supabase admin.createUser) — same pattern owner registration uses; eliminates SMTP dependency for registration
- Auto-login immediately after registration in frontend (`signInWithPassword`) — removes email confirmation step entirely from UX
- SQL to auto-confirm existing users only updates `email_confirmed_at` (NOT `confirmed_at` — it's a generated column)
- Landing page section renamed "Live JV Deals" → "Featured Deals" with "Investor First" badge; single-column vertical feed (max-width 560px)
- New CSS classes prefixed `ivx-card-` to avoid conflicts; "Project Reels" removed (interleaved by `ivx-home-feed.js`)
- Supabase project-level `mailer_autoconfirm=true` via Management API PATCH — makes `supabase.auth.signUp()` return a session immediately, fixing ALL app signup paths at once (signup.tsx, IVXAuthCard, QuickBuyModal)
- Mobile app `member-register.tsx` skips Verify step entirely → goes to Dashboard
- Mobile app `signup.tsx` auto-navigates to login after 1.5s on registration success

2. Fix `expo/components/IVXAuthCard.tsx` — skip `setStep('verify_email')` + `sendEmailCode` after successful registration; go to `setStep('complete')` instead
3. Fix `expo/components/QuickBuyModal.tsx` — verify it handles registration correctly with auto-login
4. Commit all mobile app + backend changes to GitHub (need `CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE`)
5. Deploy backend to Render (need `CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY`)
6. Call `update_supabase_auth_config` with `{mailer_autoconfirm: true}` once backend deployed
7. Run live end-to-end canary on all surfaces (landing page done; need app verification)

- `auth-context.tsx` line ~2213: `requiresLogin: !authData.session` — the key line that needs fixing
- `IVXAuthCard.tsx` line ~651: `setStep('verify_email')` + `MemberService.sendEmailCode(result.userId)` — sends email verification code even though email is already confirmed
- `member-register.tsx` line ~272: was `setStep('Verify')` → now edited to `setStep('Dashboard')` (uncommitted)
